citeAs: Anonymous Authors. Safety Beyond Refusal. Anonymous conference submission, 2026.
conditionsOfAccess: The release contains identifiers, hash bindings, derived aggregate tables, paper tables, and raster figures only. Credentials, private manifests, prompts, responses, reasoning, journals, and interrupted runs are excluded.
description: Release-safe aggregates for Safety Beyond Refusal. The three axes remain separate: harmful-request refusal, welfare-preserving one-shot choice, and repeated-commons restraint. Counts are computed from the hash-bound release: 22 Part 0 models over 3168 scheduled responses; 75 Part 1 models over 28800 scheduled choices; and 19 Part 2 models over 228 trajectories, of which 225 are environmentally estimable. No cross-axis composite score is released.

name: Prosocial Readiness Bench definitive aggregate release
rai:dataAnnotationProtocol: Part 0 uses one fixed judge disjoint from every evaluated subject. Parts 1 and 2 use deterministic structured-action parsing. Primary denominators retain first-attempt invalids; semantic repairs are isolated supplements.
rai:dataCollection: The definitive panels contain 22 Part 0, 75 Part 1, and 19 Part 2 model routes. Part 2 contains 228 scheduled trajectories, 225 environmentally estimable trajectories, 3 semantic-invalid trajectories, and 4 first-attempt invalid actions. The separate role-calibration and deadline sensitivity releases contain 18 model-frame rows, 5 sentinel models, and 25 prespecified effects.
rai:dataLimitations: Part 0 remains exploratory pending completed human judge validation and benign controls.
Part 1 remains exploratory pending independent prompt-bank content approval.
Part 2 is an artificial repeated-commons environment; it does not identify intent.
Finite-bank intervals for Parts 0 and 1 do not claim population sampling uncertainty.
Availability and semantic-repair panels are reported separately and never replace primary denominators.
rai:dataReleaseMaintenancePlan: Regenerate only from self-hashed complete aggregate directories; any inventory, hash, privacy, or source-binding mismatch blocks publication.
rai:dataUseCases: Reproduce axis-specific descriptive tables, intervals, and figures.
Audit model-route coverage, invalid handling, and evidence status.
Not supported: a latent altruism score, global safety ranking, or deployment certification.
rai:personalSensitiveInformation: No human-subject records or personal user data are released.
